content.text: Updated: Mar. 27, 2026, 3:11 p.m.Published: Mar. 27, 2026, 3:11 p.m.Los Angeles Angels' Mike Trout, right, celebrates his home run with third base coach Eric Young Sr. during the first inning of a baseball game against the Baltimore Orioles, Tuesday, April 23, 2024, in Anaheim, Calif. (AP Photo/Ryan Sun)APIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By John Holland | The Oregonian/OregonLiveThe 2026 MLB season is upon us, which means Apple TV+ Friday Night Baseball is back with more double features. Today’s slate features the Houston Astros facing the Los Angeles Angels. The first pitch is scheduled on Friday, March 27, at 5:10 p.m. PT/8:10 p.m. ET (6:10 p.m. MT) with a live broadcast on Apple TV+ (free trial).What TV channel is the Astros vs. Angels Friday Night Baseball on? Is it streaming free anywhere?Apple TV is not a traditional television network, but Apple’s flagship streaming service. Right now, they are offering a seven-day free trial, with the service prices at $12.99 a month once the trial ends.When: Friday, March 27, at 5:10 p.m. PT/8:10 p.m. ET (6:10 p.m. MT)Where: Daikin Park | Houston, TexasTV channel: Friday Night Baseball on Apple TV+How to watch streaming live: Friday Night Baseball on Apple TV (free trial) is available to active Apple TV+ subscribers for free right now, and $12.99 a month after the free trial ends. Apple TV+ (free trial) subscribers also get access to a plethora of great content, including Apple TV’s popular shows like Monarch Legacy of Montsers, Imperfect Women, Hijack, Severence, Ted Lasso, Pachinko, For All Mankind, Shrinking, Slow Horses, and lots of other options.
